name: Ryuugazaki Rei
source:
Rei is Nagisa's classmate. He is handsome and intelligent, but is often manipulated by Nagisa for some reason. He is heavily attracted to all things beautiful, both tangible and non-tangible, and will do everything in his power to avoid things he claims "unattractive".

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free!_(anime)]Wikipedia[/url]]
